policy: Only official versions with an explicit license can be APPROVED; every source whose origin or terms are unclear is HOLD.
approval_scope: 'production' may enter a production freeze; 'dev_experiment' may be used only in DEV experiments and needs a new rights review before any production freeze.
Only APPROVED sources may be imported; the importer rejects any source whose rights fields are unknown.
training_use (AI / statistical model training) and redistribution are recorded separately.
Raw third-party files stay under data/raw/daily/ (gitignored) and are never committed; only this manifest and SHA-256 hashes are.
No simplified-to-traditional conversion: simplified or mixed-script text is dropped, never converted.

Approved for DEV experiments only: before any production freeze the data rights (contributor terms, copied third-party text, personal data) must be reviewed again. sources.reason: Governance issues: (1) it is unclear that end users consented to publication and relicensing of their prompts; (2) personal information in real user logs is not documented as reviewed; (3) answers are output of commercial models whose terms restrict using outputs to develop competing models; (4) the uploader's Apache-2.0 declaration over third-party user content is not backed by a documented rights chain.
